3M / Solventum.evidence: Solventum was spun off from 3M and operates as a standalone public company providing advanced wound care solutions including negative pressure wound therapy and advanced dressings according to the Solventum company website and product catalog.

Icon Pharma Sdn Bhd.evidence: Icon Pharma Sdn Bhd is a real company established in 2010 through the UKM-MTDC Symbiosis Programme in Malaysia that offers an advanced wound care solution named Hydro moist care, according to an official announcement post from the Malaysian Technology Development Corporation (MTDC).
